independenceProtocol.sharedInputs: Frozen canonical corpus metadata, Item/Step structure, sourceShape, executionPattern, schedule, and title.

iterations.rules: General temporal-intent, field-versus-Item, relative-plan, and lesson-progress tie-breakers added without exposing either classifier output.

iterationDecision.reason: Round 1 primary projection agreement missed the threshold. Round 2 reached both required thresholds without exposing either classifier output to the other.

disagreements.title: Allblanc 7일 복근 챌린지
disagreements.cause: A seven-day challenge is both a finite sequence and a set of independently completed daily workouts; one classifier also prioritized the resolved Calendar while the other prioritized the progress overview.
disagreements.tieBreaker: Across days, daily workouts are Todo-style progress units; Calendar is primary only after the start anchor is confirmed. The exercise steps inside a single day may still render as Checklist.

agentA.evidence: The seven-video challenge is a bounded sequence, and one workout is truly placed on each Day 1–7 anchor offset after a start date is chosen.

agentB.evidence: The seven relative Day 1~7 workout rows have no fixed personal start occurrence, so the challenge needs a progress sheet before calendar overlay.

disagreements.title: 리모델링 공정별 하자 점검
disagreements.cause: Independent defect rows are individually actionable, but the source defines a finite inspection scope where omissions matter.
disagreements.tieBreaker: Use Checklist semantics for the bounded inspection session and Sheet as the primary status overview.

agentA.evidence: The 13 defect rows carry photo, repair-request, and recheck status Fields whose cross-row overview is primary, while each inspection or follow-up executes separately.

agentB.evidence: The omission-sensitive inspection spans twelve trade rows with issue, photo, repair-request, and recheck status Fields that require an overview.
